Más allá de Puerto Bravo hay otra ciudad: Beyond Puerto Bravo there is another city, San Lucero, two towns, Villaseca and Cala Brava, and a sea with an island. You get there by road in a vehicle, by bus from the station or by boat from a pier. By road, drive to a city exit and, without getting out, press Enter. The GPS knows how to guide you between towns.
Para aprenderte una ciudad sin moverte,: To learn a city without moving, press F9: the map explorer moves a cursor from intersection to intersection and tells you what is at each one.
Para ir a un sitio, pulsa L, elige el lu: To go somewhere, press L, choose the place and press Enter. The GPS will tell you which way to go and a beacon will sound in the direction you should follow. Press G to repeat the instruction.
Puedes trabajar con un taxi, repartir pi: You can work with a taxi, deliver pizzas, drive ambulances, buses and trucks, fish, run races, buy houses, businesses, cars and boats, or gamble your money at the casino. The phone, with the M key, brings it all together.
Puerto Bravo. Una ciudad de mar, con un: Puerto Bravo. A city by the sea, with a harbor that never sleeps and a beach that never rests.
Pulsa C en cualquier momento para saber: Press C at any time to find out where you are. Press Tab to sweep what is near you with the radar: each thing sounds from its position and is announced with its distance.
Si te metes en líos, pulsa Q para fijar: If you get into trouble, press Q to lock onto the enemy: you will hear a tone coming from where they are. Space attacks, R reloads and Z uses a first aid kit. From a vehicle you can also shoot without getting out: Q locks on the same way and Ctrl fires, with a firearm in your hand.
Si tienes un mando de Xbox o de PlayStat: If you have an Xbox or PlayStation controller, plug it in: the game recognizes it by itself, vibrates with what happens and the help tells you what each button does.
Te llamas Dani Roca. Hace tres años te c: Your name is Dani Roca. Three years ago you were convicted of a robbery you did not commit. This morning the gates of Monteferro Prison opened.
Tutorial. Puedes saltarlo con Escape y r: Tutorial. You can skip it with Escape and repeat any sentence with the up arrow. All the keys are always in the help, with F1.
